propositions: run_git_write lacks retry coverage for write-side temp-file faults (unable to create temporary file, failed to insert into database, unable to index file) because _with_transient_head_retry only matches read-side markers (_TRANSIENT_HEAD_MARKERS, _TRANSIENT_OBJECT_MARKERS)

event_append._git_add and _git_commit self-heal from the same write-side faults via a private _TRANSIENT_ADD_MARKERS and _with_transient_add_retry, leaving all other run_git_write callers (s3_doctor, compaction, claim/transition writers) unprotected

The write-side marker family must be moved into gitutil as a shared definition with a new _is_transient_object_write_error predicate, folded into the transient classifier and renamed to _is_transient_git_fault, so all run_git_write callers inherit bounded 3-attempt retry

event_append must delete its private marker family and retry loop, re-export the shared predicate as _is_transient_add_error for test compatibility, and route all five composition sites plus _git_add through _with_transient_fault_retry to collapse accidental 3x3 nested budget to intended bounded 3
Corrupt-object signatures (loose object is corrupt, inflate: data stream error) and index.lock faults must remain excluded from retry and fail immediately

Renamed symbols in gitutil (_is_transient_head_error to _is_transient_git_fault, _with_transient_head_retry to _with_transient_fault_retry, constants to _TRANSIENT_FAULT_ATTEMPTS/_TRANSIENT_FAULT_BACKOFF_S) must be repointed in test_run_git_wrapper.py to prevent import breakage
